query: SELECT ca.id, ca.customerId, ca.currentBalanceUsd, c.fullName FROM customerAccounts ca JOIN customers c ON ca.customerId = c.id WHERE CAST(ca.currentBalanceUsd AS DECIMAL(12,2)) > 0 LIMIT 10;
